catalog.name: Products and Catalog calculations
catalog.description: Every formula, algorithm, rounding rule and worked example of the products and catalog domain, in a structured form a rebuild can test against: the identifier string of a combination and its restriction to variant-creating members, the materialisation of template attribute values, the variant generation algorithm with its ceiling and its single-value repair, the four possibility predicates with the own-exclusion, inverse and parent-exclusion maps, the finding and the on-demand creation of a variant, the pruned enumeration of possible combinations and the closest-combination search, the extra prices of a variant and of values that never create a variant, the two price computations for the sales price and for the cost with their unit and currency conversions, the base price of a choice group and the proration of a combination product's price with its rounding remainder, the product matrix and its header cells, the barcode check digit, encoding check, sanitising, pattern matching and classic parsing, the uniform resource identifier decodings, the Global Standards One separator, symbology stripping, four content-type interpretations, six-digit date conversion, decomposition loop and search unpadding, the category and variant names, the vendor-specific references and the staged product search, the four expiry day counts with the lot dates, the move line dates, the generated lot lines, the free-text date reading and the expiry reminder, the category product count, the label page count, the vendor selection, and the precision, rounding and currency-conversion summary of the domain.
catalog.authored_from: docs/domains/products-and-catalog/calculations.md, with the combination pricing invariants of docs/domains/products-and-catalog/accounting-effects.md and the rule identifiers of docs/domains/products-and-catalog/business-rules.md

records.name: The identifier string of a combination
records.purpose: Turns a set of Template Attribute Values into the single text key by which a variant is stored and found, so that two systems that hold the same combination hold the same key.

operands.name: identifiers of the members of the combination
operands.source: the Template Attribute Values chosen on the template, at most one per attribute line
operands.constraints: every member belongs to an attribute line of the same template; no two members share an attribute line

operands.name: number of members
operands.source: the combination itself
operands.constraints: zero or more; zero is the empty combination

preconditions.condition: Every member belongs to an attribute line of the template whose variant is being keyed.
preconditions.otherwise: The key would name a value the template does not offer and no variant would ever match it; the possibility predicate rejects such a combination before it is keyed.

preconditions.condition: The identifiers are whole numbers, so that ascending numeric order is defined.
preconditions.otherwise: The order would be lexical and two systems could produce different keys for the same set.

procedure: Take the identifiers of the members of the combination.
Sort them in ascending numeric order, so that the key does not depend on the order in which the values were chosen.
Join them with a comma and no space.
The result is the combination identifier string, stored on a variant as its combination indices.
records.formula: combination_identifier_string = join_with_comma( sort_ascending( identifiers_of_members ) )

rounding.what: Nothing. The operands are whole-number identifiers and the result is text.

result.name: combination identifier string
result.stored_or_displayed: stored on the Product Variant as its combination indices; used as the search key when a variant is found from a combination

edge_cases.case: The combination is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The identifier string is the empty text. A template with no attribute lines has exactly one variant, whose combination indices are empty.

edge_cases.case: The stored combination indices are unset rather than empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The lookup for the empty key matches both the empty text and the unset value, so an unset field behaves as the empty combination.

edge_cases.case: Two members share one attribute line.
edge_cases.outcome: The set is not a combination; the configuration filter rejects it because the count of members no longer equals the count of lines.

edge_cases.case: A member whose attribute never creates variants is present.
edge_cases.outcome: It takes part in the identifier string of the chosen combination but not in the string stored on a variant, which is built from the filtered combination only.

worked_examples.description: The six combinations of a template carrying a size attribute and a colour attribute
worked_examples.narrative: Two attribute lines, one offering three values and one offering two, give three multiplied by two, that is six combinations. Each key is the two member identifiers sorted ascending and joined by a comma, so the pair made of Size L and Colour Black is keyed `103,104` whatever order the buyer answered the two questions in.

records.name: The restriction of a combination to its variant-creating members
records.purpose: Separates the members that are stored on a variant from the members that only travel with the request, so that a chosen configuration and the variant that serves it can differ by exactly the values of attributes that never create variants.

operands.name: members of the chosen combination
operands.source: the configuration chosen by the caller, which must be complete
operands.constraints: at most one member per attribute line

operands.name: variant-creation mode of each member's attribute
operands.source: the Product Attribute behind each member
operands.constraints: one of the three values

preconditions.condition: The combination handed in is complete, including the members of attributes that never create variants.
preconditions.otherwise: A parent exclusion carried by a never-creating value would be missed, and an impossible configuration would be accepted.

procedure: Drop from the combination every member whose attribute's variant-creation mode is never.
Keep every other member, whatever its display type.
The remainder is the filtered combination, and only that is written on a variant.
Key the filtered combination with the identifier string rule to obtain the variant's combination indices.
records.formula: filtered_combination = members of combination whose attribute variant_create_mode ≠ never ; stored_combination_indices = join_with_comma( sort_ascending( identifiers_of( filtered_combination ) ) )

rounding.what: Nothing; the operation is a selection over a set.

result.name: filtered combination
result.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: stored on the Product Variant as its combination and, keyed, as its combination indices

edge_cases.case: Every member belongs to an attribute that never creates variants.
edge_cases.outcome: The filtered combination is empty and the template has a single variant carrying the empty key, however many values the buyer chose.

edge_cases.case: An attribute's mode was changed from instantly to never after variants already existed.
edge_cases.outcome: Values of that attribute may still be stored on existing variants; the extra-price rule therefore excludes members already in the variant's own combination rather than looking at the attribute's mode.

edge_cases.case: A member of a multi-checkbox attribute is present.
edge_cases.outcome: Multi-checkbox attributes may not create variants, so such a member is always dropped by this restriction.

worked_examples.description: A pack whose engraving attribute never creates variants
worked_examples.narrative: The engraving member is dropped because its attribute never creates variants, so the template has one variant per paper value and the chosen engraving travels with the request instead of with the variant.

records.name: Materialising the template attribute values of a line
records.purpose: Brings the Template Attribute Values of one attribute line into agreement with the list of values the line offers, reusing archived records wherever possible so that existing variants keep their members.

operands.name: offered value list of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the template attribute line being created or written
operands.constraints: every offered value belongs to the line's attribute; an active line must offer at least one value

operands.name: existing Template Attribute Values of the line
operands.source: the line, archived records included
operands.constraints: each names one underlying Attribute Value

operands.name: archived Template Attribute Values of the same template and attribute attached to another line
operands.source: the template
operands.constraints: grouped by underlying value; the first of each group is the reusable one

operands.name: default extra price of each underlying Attribute Value
operands.source: the Attribute Value record
operands.constraints: copied onto a newly created Template Attribute Value

preconditions.condition: The line exists and its offered value list is the desired state.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to reconcile and the routine does not run.

preconditions.condition: The caller has not suppressed the materialisation step.
preconditions.otherwise: The values are left as they are and the caller takes responsibility for reconciling them later.

procedure: Let the remaining set be the identifiers of the values the line offers.

For each existing Template Attribute Value of the line: if its underlying value is not in the remaining set, mark it for deletion but only when it is currently active, because an archived record means an earlier deletion attempt already failed; otherwise remove that identifier from the remaining set and, when the record is archived, mark it for reactivation.

Search the archived Template Attribute Values of the same template and the same attribute whose underlying value is still in the remaining set and that are attached to another line, group them by underlying value, take the first of each group, set it active, re-attach it to this line, remove it from the deletion set and remove its underlying value from the remaining set.

Create a new Template Attribute Value for each identifier left in the remaining set, taken in ascending order, each carrying the line, the underlying value and an extra price copied from the underlying value's default extra price.
Apply the reactivations first and the archivals second, per line, before moving to the next line, so that a later line can reuse a value a previous line has just released.
After every line has been processed, delete the values still marked for deletion and then create the queued new values.
Unless variant creation is suppressed, run the variant generation algorithm on the templates involved.
records.formula: remaining = identifiers_of( offered_values ) ; for each existing value V: ( V.underlying ∉ remaining and V active ) ⇒ delete(V) ; ( V.underlying ∈ remaining ) ⇒ remaining = remaining − V.underlying and ( V archived ⇒ reactivate(V) ) ; reusable archived values of the same template and attribute are re-attached and removed from remaining ; created_values = remaining in ascending order ; number_of_active_values_of_the_line = number_of_offered_values

rounding.what: The extra price copied onto a newly created Template Attribute Value.
rounding.precision: The `Product Price` decimal precision, two digits by default.
rounding.step: At the moment the new record is written; the copy itself is exact, so rounding only bites when the source value carries more digits than the precision.

result.name: the set of active Template Attribute Values of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: stored as Template Attribute Values attached to the line; each offered value has exactly one active record and no non-offered value has one

edge_cases.case: A Template Attribute Value that must disappear is referenced by a document.
edge_cases.outcome: Its deletion fails; the deletion path catches the failure record by record and archives instead.

edge_cases.case: An already archived Template Attribute Value names a value the line no longer offers.
edge_cases.outcome: It is left alone, because being archived already records that it could not be deleted.

edge_cases.case: A value is moved from one line of the template to another line of the same attribute.
edge_cases.outcome: The archived record is re-attached to the new line rather than recreated, which keeps every variant that references it.

edge_cases.case: The offered value list becomes empty on an active line.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is refused: an active line must offer at least one value.

worked_examples.description: Removing one value from a line and adding it back on another line of the same attribute
worked_examples.narrative: Dropping L marks its Template Attribute Value for deletion, the deletion fails because two variants reference it and the record is archived instead. Offering L on the second line finds that archived record, re-attaches it and sets it active, so nothing is created and the two variants keep their member.

records.name: The variant generation algorithm
records.purpose: Keeps the set of a template's variants in step with its attribute configuration, creating the variants a new configuration makes possible, reactivating those that become possible again and removing those that no longer are.

operands.name: set of templates to process
operands.source: the operation that triggered generation: template creation, a write touching attribute lines, reactivation of a template with no variants, value materialisation, an exclusion change or the deletion of an attribute line
operands.constraints: may be empty, in which case the routine stops immediately

operands.name: valid attribute lines of the template
operands.source: the template's attribute lines that offer at least one value
operands.constraints: restricted to attributes whose variant-creation mode is not never

operands.name: all variants of the template
operands.source: the template, archived variants included
operands.constraints: sorted by activity flag ascending then identifier descending, which fixes which duplicate survives

operands.name: variant ceiling
operands.source: the system parameter `product.dynamic_variant_limit` (dynamic variant limit)
operands.constraints: one thousand by default

preconditions.condition: Every pending change is written to storage before the queries run.
preconditions.otherwise: The enumeration would read a stale configuration and would create or remove the wrong variants.

preconditions.condition: Generation has not been suppressed by the caller.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is created, reactivated or removed and the caller is responsible for running generation later.

procedure: Stop immediately when the input set of templates is empty.
Flush every pending change to storage so that the queries see a consistent state.
Initialise three accumulators: the list of combinations to create, the set of variants to activate and the set of variants to remove.
For each template, take its valid attribute lines restricted to attributes that create variants, and read all its variants including archived ones in the stated order.
Run the single-value repair, which enriches existing variants with the value of any line that offers exactly one value.
Build the lookup from each existing variant's combination to that variant.

When the template has no dynamic attribute, enumerate the full cartesian product of the active materialised values of each line, filter it with the configuration filter ignoring attributes that never create variants, add the combinations already present to the activation set, queue a creation for each combination that is absent, and refuse the whole operation when the number of queued creations exceeds the ceiling.

When the template has at least one dynamic attribute and already has variants, run the combinations of the existing variants through the same configuration filter and add the surviving variants to the activation set; queue no creation, because a dynamic template's variants come into existence one at a time.
Add to the removal set every variant of the template that is not in its activation set.
Activate the variants to activate whose template is active, so that a variant of an archived template stays archived.
Create the queued variants.
Put the removal set through the delete-or-archive procedure, then check that every input template still exists and refuse when one has disappeared because deleting its last variant deleted it.
Delete every combo item that names a removed variant.
Flush and invalidate every cache, because the collections read with archived records included are now stale.
records.formula: possible_combinations = configuration_filter( cartesian_product( active_values_of_each_line ) ) ; to_activate = possible_combinations ∩ existing ; to_create = possible_combinations − existing ; to_remove = all_variants − to_activate ; number_of_variants_after = number_of_possible_combinations ( non-dynamic template ) ; number_of_variants_after = number_of_surviving_existing_variants ( dynamic template )

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded; the outputs are counts of records.

result.name: the set of active variants of each template
result.stored_or_displayed: stored as Product Variants; the counts of created, reactivated and removed variants are the observable result

edge_cases.case: The template has no attribute line at all.
edge_cases.outcome: The cartesian product over no factors yields the empty combination, which the configuration filter accepts, so the template keeps exactly one variant with an empty key.

edge_cases.case: The template has a dynamic attribute and no variant yet.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is enumerated and nothing is created; the template legitimately holds zero variants until one is created on demand.

edge_cases.case: A configuration leaves no possible combination.
edge_cases.outcome: Removing the last variant deletes the template, the existence check fires and the operation is refused with the message reproduced in the business rules.

edge_cases.case: The template is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: Its variants are not reactivated; the activation step skips variants whose template is inactive.

edge_cases.case: A variant to remove is referenced by a document.
edge_cases.outcome: It is archived rather than deleted, and every combo item naming it is deleted in either case.

worked_examples.description: Generating the six variants of a template with a size attribute and a colour attribute
worked_examples.narrative: Three sizes multiplied by two colours give six combinations, none excluded, none already present, so six variants are created. The single attribute-less variant created with the template has an empty combination, is therefore not in the enumeration, and is deleted.

worked_examples.description: Re-running generation after an exclusion is added
worked_examples.narrative: The union of the values excluded by the members of the pair made of Size L and Colour White is the set holding Size L, which intersects the pair itself, so that one combination is skipped. The five survivors are already active, and the sixth variant is deleted when nothing references it and archived otherwise.

records.name: The variant generation ceiling
records.purpose: Caps the number of variants one template may generate in a single pass, so that a configuration with many attributes cannot create an unusable catalogue.

operands.name: number of creations queued for this template
operands.source: the creation queue of the generation algorithm, counted as each combination is queued
operands.constraints: a whole number, counted per template and not across the whole input set

operands.name: variant ceiling
operands.source: the system parameter `product.dynamic_variant_limit` (dynamic variant limit)
operands.constraints: one thousand when the parameter is absent

preconditions.condition: The template has no dynamic attribute, so that creations are queued at all.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is queued and the ceiling is never reached, however many combinations exist.

procedure: Count the creations queued for this template as each surviving combination is added.
Compare the running count with the ceiling after each addition.
Refuse the whole operation as soon as the count is strictly greater than the ceiling, so that a count exactly equal to the ceiling is allowed.
Report the refusal with the message reproduced in the business rules, which tells the user to stop generating a variant per combination or to switch the attribute to dynamic creation.
records.formula: refuse when number_of_queued_creations > variant_ceiling ; allowed_maximum = variant_ceiling ; variant_ceiling = 1000 by default

rounding.what: Nothing; both operands are whole counts.
rounding.method: None; the comparison is strictly greater than.

result.name: acceptance or refusal of the generation pass
result.stored_or_displayed: displayed as a blocking message; nothing is stored when the ceiling is exceeded, because the whole operation is refused

edge_cases.case: The number of queued creations is exactly one thousand.
edge_cases.outcome: Accepted, because the comparison is strictly greater than the ceiling.

edge_cases.case: The number of queued creations is one thousand and one.
edge_cases.outcome: Refused, and no variant of any template in the pass is created.

edge_cases.case: Two templates each queue six hundred creations in the same pass.
edge_cases.outcome: Both are accepted: the count is kept per template, not across the pass.

edge_cases.case: The parameter holds a value that is not a whole number.
edge_cases.outcome: The default of one thousand applies, because the parameter is read as a whole number with that fallback.

worked_examples.description: Four attributes whose value counts multiply past the ceiling
worked_examples.narrative: Ten multiplied by ten multiplied by ten multiplied by two is two thousand combinations. The queue is checked after each addition, so the refusal fires on the one thousand and first, and nothing is created.

worked_examples.description: A configuration that lands exactly on the ceiling
worked_examples.narrative: One thousand is not strictly greater than one thousand, so the pass completes and one thousand variants are created.

records.name: The single-value repair of existing variants
records.purpose: Enriches the existing variants of a template with the value of every line that offers exactly one value, so that adding such an attribute does not destroy and recreate the catalogue.

operands.name: valid attribute lines that create variants
operands.source: the template
operands.constraints: each offers at least one value

operands.name: single lines
operands.source: the lines whose active materialised values number exactly one
operands.constraints: counted over active Template Attribute Values only

operands.name: current combination of each variant
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: each variant of the template
operands.constraints: at most one member per line

preconditions.condition: At least one line offers exactly one active value.
preconditions.otherwise: The repair does nothing and the ordinary enumeration decides the variant set.

procedure: Collect the lines whose active materialised values number exactly one.
For each variant of the template, form the union of the variant's current combination with the active values of those single lines.

Write that union onto the variant only when all three of these hold: the union has exactly as many members as there are lines, the set of lines it covers is exactly the set of lines, and it differs from the variant's current combination.
Leave the variant untouched when any of the three fails, so that a partially configured variant is not silently completed.
records.formula: enriched_combination = current_combination ∪ active_values_of( single_lines ) ; write when count( enriched_combination ) = count( lines ) and lines_covered( enriched_combination ) = lines and enriched_combination ≠ current_combination

rounding.what: Nothing; the comparison is between counts of members and counts of lines.

result.name: the enriched combination of each existing variant
result.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: stored on the Product Variant; the variant keeps its identity, its references and its documents

edge_cases.case: The new single-value line is the template's only line and the template had one attribute-less variant.
edge_cases.outcome: The union has one member and covers the one line, so the attribute-less variant is enriched rather than deleted and recreated.

edge_cases.case: The union covers fewer lines than the template has.
edge_cases.outcome: The variant is left alone and the ordinary enumeration decides its fate.

edge_cases.case: The single line later acquires a second value.
edge_cases.outcome: The repair no longer applies to it, the enumeration multiplies out and new variants are created for the added value.

edge_cases.case: The enriched combination equals the current one.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is written, so no modification timestamp changes and no cache is invalidated for that variant.

worked_examples.description: Adding a material attribute that offers a single value
worked_examples.narrative: Each existing variant's two members are joined by Material Oak, giving three members across the three lines, so the union is written onto the variant. No variant is created or removed, and the display name is unchanged because a member from a single-value line is filtered out of the combination name.

worked_examples.description: Adding a second value to that material line afterwards
worked_examples.narrative: Three sizes multiplied by two colours multiplied by two materials is twelve combinations; six already exist, so six are created, and the material member now appears in every display name because its line is no longer a single-value line.

records.name: The extra price and the sales price of a generated variant
records.purpose: Gives each generated variant the price the template carries plus the supplements its own members declare, which is the price a document line starts from before any pricelist rule is applied.

operands.name: template sales price
operands.source: the sales price of the Product Template
operands.constraints: may be zero; read as zero when unset

operands.name: extra price of each member of the variant's combination
operands.source: each Template Attribute Value stored on the variant
operands.constraints: may be zero, positive or negative; expressed in the template's currency, never in another

preconditions.condition: The variant's combination is the filtered combination, holding only members of attributes that create variants.
preconditions.otherwise: A supplement of an attribute that never creates variants would be counted here instead of travelling through the price context, and would be applied to every buyer.

preconditions.condition: Every member's extra price is in the template's currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The sum would mix currencies; the extra prices are held in the template's currency by construction.

procedure: Sum the extra price of every Template Attribute Value in the variant's stored combination.
Leave that sum unrounded; it is displayed at the `Product Price` decimal precision.
Add the sum to the template's sales price to obtain the variant's sales price in the product's own unit of measure.
records.formula:
variant_price_extra = sum_of( extra_price of each Template Attribute Value in the variant combination )
variant_sales_price = template_sales_price + variant_price_extra

rounding.what: The displayed extra price and the displayed sales price.
rounding.precision: The `Product Price` decimal precision, two digits by default.
rounding.step: At display; the sum itself is not rounded, and the addition is performed on the unrounded figures.

result.name: variant sales price
result.unit_or_currency: the template's currency, per the product's default unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: computed and displayed on the Product Variant; writing it inverts the computation onto the template's sales price

edge_cases.case: The variant has no member with a non-zero extra price.
edge_cases.outcome: The extra is zero and the variant's sales price equals the template's sales price.

edge_cases.case: A member carries a negative extra price.
edge_cases.outcome: It is summed as it stands, so a variant may be cheaper than its template; no floor at zero is applied.

edge_cases.case: The template's sales price is unset.
edge_cases.outcome: It is read as zero and the variant's sales price is the extra alone.

edge_cases.case: A member belongs to an attribute that never creates variants but is still stored on the variant after a mode change.
edge_cases.outcome: It is counted here, and the context-borne extra excludes it precisely so that it is not counted twice.

worked_examples.description: The six variants of the office chair with two supplements
worked_examples.narrative: Each variant sums the supplements of its own two members and adds them to the template's one hundred. The dearest pair, Size L with Colour White, carries five plus two, that is seven, giving one hundred and seven.

records.name: Deleting or archiving a variant that is no longer possible
records.purpose: Decides, for each variant that a configuration change has made impossible, whether the record disappears or survives as an archived record, so that history kept by other domains is never broken.

operands.name: set of variants to remove
operands.source: the removal accumulator of the generation algorithm
operands.constraints: may be empty, in which case nothing happens

operands.name: references to each variant from other records
operands.unit_or_currency: a count of references, no unit
operands.source: any document that names the variant: a sales order line, a stock move, a valuation layer or any other
operands.constraints: a single reference is enough to prevent deletion

preconditions.condition: The removal set is non-empty.
preconditions.otherwise: The procedure is skipped entirely and no existence check is run.

procedure: Attempt to delete the whole batch of variants at once.
On failure, halve the batch and attempt each half, repeating until the failing records are isolated.
Archive each individual record that cannot be deleted, so that a variant referenced by any document survives as an archived record.
Delete every variant that no document references.
After the batch, re-check that every template given to the generation algorithm still exists, because deleting the last variant of a non-dynamic template deletes the template too.
Delete every combo item that names a removed variant, whether it was deleted or archived.
records.formula: outcome( variant ) = deleted when references( variant ) = 0 ; outcome( variant ) = archived when references( variant ) ≥ 1 ; templates_after = templates_before − templates whose last variant was deleted

rounding.what: Nothing; the operands are counts of references and the outcome is a verdict.

result.name: the disposition of each removed variant
result.unit_or_currency: a verdict per record, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: stored as the presence or the activity flag of the Product Variant, and as the deletion of the combo items naming it

edge_cases.case: The batch deletion fails because one variant of many is referenced.
edge_cases.outcome: The halving isolates it; the others are still deleted and only the referenced one is archived.

edge_cases.case: Deleting the last variant deletes the non-dynamic template.
edge_cases.outcome: The existence check afterwards finds the template gone and the whole operation is refused with the message reproduced in the business rules.

edge_cases.case: Archiving the last active variant of a template.
edge_cases.outcome: The template is archived, which archives the variant again; the second archival is a harmless repetition and must not loop.

edge_cases.case: A removed variant is offered inside a choice group.
edge_cases.outcome: Every combo item naming it is deleted, so the choice group loses that item.

worked_examples.description: Removing three variants of which one has been sold
worked_examples.narrative: The batch of three fails, the halving isolates the sold variant, the two unsold ones are deleted and the sold one is archived. The single combo item naming it is deleted in both branches, and the template survives because other variants remain.

records.name: The configuration filter over candidate combinations
records.purpose: Keeps, out of a stream of candidate combinations, those that name exactly one value per attribute line the template uses and that no exclusion forbids; it is the first and cheapest of the four possibility tests.

operands.name: stream of candidate combinations
operands.unit_or_currency: sets of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the cartesian product of the generation algorithm, the pruned enumeration, or a single combination handed in by a caller
operands.constraints: each candidate holds at most one value per line

operands.name: flag saying whether attributes that never create variants are ignored
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: set by the generation algorithm, cleared when a complete chosen configuration is being tested

operands.name: valid attribute lines of the template
operands.source: the template
operands.constraints: a valid line offers at least one value

operands.name: all active materialised values of those lines
operands.source: the Template Attribute Values of the lines
operands.constraints: archived values are not in this set

operands.name: own-exclusion map
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from value identifier to a list of value identifiers
operands.source: the exclusion records owned by the template's values
operands.constraints: holds a key for every eligible value, possibly with an empty list

preconditions.condition: The preparation is done once for the whole stream: the lines, the active values, the optional removal of lines whose attribute never creates variants, the lines whose display type is not multi-checkbox, and the own-exclusion map.
preconditions.otherwise: Recomputing per candidate gives the same verdicts but multiplies the cost by the length of the stream.

preconditions.condition: The own-exclusion map holds a key for every eligible value.
preconditions.otherwise: The membership test would have to guard against a missing key; the map is built so that it never is.

procedure: Restrict the candidate to the members whose attribute's display type is not multi-checkbox.
Reject when the number of those members differs from the number of lines whose display type is not multi-checkbox, because the candidate does not name exactly one value per non-multi attribute.
Reject when the set of lines covered by those members is not exactly the set of non-multi lines, because the candidate names a value of an attribute the template does not use or omits one it does.
Reject when the candidate is not a subset of the active materialised values, because it names a value the template no longer offers or one that is archived.
When the own-exclusion map is non-empty, form the union of the values excluded by each member of the candidate and reject when that union intersects the candidate.
Accept otherwise, and pass the candidate on.
records.formula:
accept( candidate ) = ( count( candidate_without_multi ) = count( lines_without_multi ) )
  and ( lines_covered( candidate_without_multi ) = lines_without_multi )
  and ( candidate ⊆ all_active_values )
  and ( union_of_excluded_values( members of candidate ) ∩ candidate = ∅ )

rounding.what: Nothing; every operand is a set or a count of members.
rounding.precision: Whole counts of members and of lines.

result.name: the stream of accepted combinations
result.unit_or_currency: sets of Template Attribute Values, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: consumed by the generation algorithm, by the enumeration of possible combinations and by the possibility predicate; never stored as such

edge_cases.case: The template has no attribute line and the candidate is empty.

edge_cases.case: The template has attribute lines and the candidate is empty.

edge_cases.case: The candidate names a value of a multi-checkbox attribute.
edge_cases.outcome: That member is ignored by the count test and by the covered-line test, because multi-checkbox lines are excluded from both sides of the comparison.

edge_cases.case: The candidate names an archived value.

edge_cases.case: Only one combination is to be tested.
edge_cases.outcome: The single-combination form runs the same filter over a one-element stream and reports whether anything came out.

worked_examples.description: Filtering the six candidates of a two-line template with one exclusion

expected_outputs.rejection_step: the union of excluded values intersects the candidate

worked_examples.narrative: Every candidate passes the three structural tests, since each names one size and one colour, both active. Only the pair holding Colour White excludes something, namely Size L, and that value is in the candidate itself, so that one candidate is rejected.

worked_examples.description: The empty candidate on a template with two lines

expected_outputs.rejection_step: the count of non-multi members, zero, differs from the count of non-multi lines, two

worked_examples.narrative: This is the test that puts the attribute-less variant of a freshly configured template into the removal set.

records.name: The own-exclusion map of a template
records.purpose: Lists, for every eligible value of a template, the values of the same template it forbids, in the form the configuration filter and the configurator both read.

operands.name: materialised values of the template's valid attribute lines
operands.source: the template
operands.constraints: archived values are included in the collection and filtered afterwards

operands.name: exclusion records owned by those values
operands.source: each Template Attribute Value's exclusion list
operands.constraints: only exclusions whose template is this template are kept

operands.name: combination of interest
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of Template Attribute Value identifiers, no unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: when given, its members count as eligible even when archived

preconditions.condition: The values considered belong to the template's valid attribute lines.
preconditions.otherwise: The map would carry keys the filter never looks up and would mislead a configurator.

procedure: Collect every materialised value of the template's valid attribute lines.
Build the value filter as: the value is active, widened to or the value belongs to the combination of interest when one was given, then narrowed to and the value is one of the collected values.
Group the template's exclusion records by their owning value, keeping only those whose owning value passes the filter and whose template is this template.

For each collected value that is active or belongs to the combination of interest: map it to the identifiers of the active values its exclusions name when it owns exclusions, and to the empty list otherwise.
Return the map, which holds a key for every eligible value even when its list is empty.
records.formula:
own_exclusion_map[ value ] = identifiers of the active values excluded by value when value owns exclusions on this template
own_exclusion_map[ value ] = [ ] otherwise
eligible( value ) = ( value active or value ∈ combination_of_interest ) and value ∈ materialised_values_of_valid_lines

rounding.what: Nothing; the map holds identifiers.

result.name: own-exclusion map
result.unit_or_currency: a map from value identifier to a list of value identifiers, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: computed on demand; consumed by the configuration filter, by the pruned enumeration and, after inverse completion, by a configurator

edge_cases.case: A value owns an exclusion naming a value that has since been archived.
edge_cases.outcome: The archived target is dropped from the list, because only active excluded values are mapped.

edge_cases.case: An archived value is part of the combination of interest.
edge_cases.outcome: It is eligible and appears as a key, which is what lets a configurator explain why an already chosen but now archived value is refused.

edge_cases.case: No exclusion exists anywhere on the template.
edge_cases.outcome: Every key maps to an empty list, the map is not empty, and the filter's exclusion step still runs but never rejects.

edge_cases.case: An exclusion record names another template.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not in this map; it belongs to the parent-exclusion map computed from the parent combination.

worked_examples.description: One exclusion owned by a colour value
worked_examples.narrative: All five values are active and belong to valid lines, so all five are keys. Only the value that owns an exclusion carries a non-empty list; the map is nonetheless complete, which is what lets the filter look every member up without guarding against a missing key.

records.name: Completing the exclusion map with its inverse pairs
records.purpose: Makes exclusion visibly symmetric for a configurator, so that a client told that one value forbids another also learns the reverse and can grey out either question first.

operands.name: own-exclusion map
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from value identifier to a list of value identifiers
operands.source: the own-exclusion map of the template
operands.constraints: holds a key for every eligible value

preconditions.condition: The map to complete is a copy, not the map the filter uses.
preconditions.otherwise: The filter would see the inverse pairs as well; it does not need them, because it already takes the union over every member.

procedure: Start from a copy of the own-exclusion map.
Visit each key and each value in that key's list, in the order the lists hold them.
When the visited value is already a key of the result and the original key is not yet in its list, append the original key to it.
Otherwise set the result's entry for that visited value to a one-element list holding the original key, which overwrites rather than appends.
Return the completed map.

rounding.what: Nothing; the map holds identifiers.

result.name: completed exclusion map
result.unit_or_currency: a map from value identifier to a list of value identifiers, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: sent to a configurator or a storefront inside the attribute-exclusion payload; never stored

edge_cases.case: The visited value is not yet a key of the result.
edge_cases.outcome: Its entry is overwritten by a one-element list; in practice every value of the template is already a key, so this branch is reached only for a value belonging to another template, which cannot happen for own exclusions.

edge_cases.case: The original key is already in the visited value's list.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is appended, so a pair declared in both directions is not duplicated.

edge_cases.case: The map is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The completion returns an empty map and the configurator greys nothing out.

worked_examples.description: One value excluding two others
worked_examples.narrative: Visiting the key for Colour Black and its first target, Size L, finds Size L already a key with an empty list that does not hold Colour Black, so Colour Black is appended. The second target, Size M, is treated the same way. The owning key keeps its own two-element list unchanged.

records.name: The parent-exclusion map
records.purpose: Lists which values of this template are forbidden by each value of the product from which this one is offered as an option or an accessory, so that an incompatible option cannot be configured alongside its parent.

operands.name: parent combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values of the parent product, no unit
operands.source: the caller, which is the document line carrying the parent product
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: exclusion records owned by the parent's values whose template is this template
operands.source: each value of the parent combination
operands.constraints: an exclusion naming no value means the whole product is incompatible

operands.name: materialised values of every attribute line of this template
operands.source: this template
operands.constraints: used in full when an exclusion names no value

preconditions.condition: A parent combination was supplied.
preconditions.otherwise: The map is empty and no parent exclusion can refuse anything.

procedure: Return an empty map at once when the parent combination is empty.
For each value of the parent combination, take the exclusion records it owns whose template is this template.
Map that parent value to the identifiers of the values the exclusion names, when it names any.

Map that parent value to every materialised value of every attribute line of this template when the exclusion names no value, which expresses that the whole product is incompatible with that parent value.
Return the map.
records.formula:
parent_exclusion_map[ parent_value ] = identifiers named by the exclusion    when the exclusion names at least one value
parent_exclusion_map[ parent_value ] = every materialised value of this template   when the exclusion names no value
parent_exclusion_map = { } when parent_combination is empty

rounding.what: Nothing; the map holds identifiers.

result.name: parent-exclusion map
result.unit_or_currency: a map from parent value identifier to a list of this template's value identifiers, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: consumed by the possibility predicate and by the pruned enumeration's rejection counter; sent to a configurator inside the attribute-exclusion payload

edge_cases.case: An exclusion owned by a parent value names no value of this template.
edge_cases.outcome: Every materialised value of this template is mapped, so no combination of this template is possible under that parent value.

edge_cases.case: The forbidden value belongs to an attribute that never creates variants.
edge_cases.outcome: It is still honoured, which is why the create-on-demand procedure insists on being given the complete combination including such members.

edge_cases.case: The parent value owns exclusions targeting a third template.
edge_cases.outcome: They are not in this map, which keeps only exclusions whose template is this one.

worked_examples.description: A parent desk whose steel legs forbid one option value and a second parent value that forbids the option outright
worked_examples.narrative: The first parent value forbids one mounting value. The second owns an exclusion that names nothing, so it forbids both mounting values, and the option cannot be configured at all under that parent.

records.name: The full possibility predicate for a combination
records.purpose: Answers whether a combination may be ordered: the strictest of the four tests, combining the configuration filter, the existence and activity of the variant, and the exclusions carried by a parent product.

operands.name: combination to test
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the caller: a configurator, a document line or the enumeration of possible combinations
operands.constraints: complete, including the members of attributes that never create variants

operands.name: parent combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values of the parent product, no unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: flag saying whether attributes that never create variants are ignored
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: set when an existing variant is being tested against its own stored combination

operands.name: presence of a dynamic attribute on the template
operands.source: the template's attribute lines
operands.constraints: true when any line uses an attribute whose variant-creation mode is `dynamic`

preconditions.condition: The combination is complete for the template's lines.
preconditions.otherwise: The configuration filter rejects it on the count test and the predicate returns false.

procedure: Return false when the configuration filter rejects the combination.
Find the variant of the combination.
When the template has at least one dynamic attribute: return false when a variant was found and it is archived, and continue when no variant was found, because one can be created on demand.
When the template has no dynamic attribute: return false when no variant was found or when the variant that was found is archived.
Compute the parent-exclusion map and return false when any value listed anywhere in it is a member of the combination.
Return true.
records.formula:
possible( combination ) = configuration_filter_accepts( combination )
  and ( dynamic_template ? not ( variant_found and variant_archived ) : ( variant_found and variant_active ) )
  and ( members( combination ) ∩ all_values_listed_in( parent_exclusion_map ) = ∅ )

rounding.what: Nothing; the result is a verdict.

result.name: possibility verdict
result.stored_or_displayed: displayed as the availability of a cell of the product matrix and of a configurator option; never stored

edge_cases.case: The template is dynamic and no variant exists for the combination.
edge_cases.outcome: The predicate may still return true, because the variant is created on demand when the combination is ordered.

edge_cases.case: The template is dynamic and the variant exists but is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: False: a dynamic combination that was explicitly archived stays refused, and the create-on-demand procedure therefore returns the archived variant untouched.

edge_cases.case: The template has no dynamic attribute and the variant is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: False, so an archived variant of a fully generated template cannot be ordered.

edge_cases.case: A member of the combination is forbidden by the parent product.
edge_cases.outcome: False, however sound the combination is on its own.

edge_cases.case: The template has no attribute line and the combination is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: True when the single attribute-less variant exists and is active.

worked_examples.description: The two pairs of a two-line template with one exclusion, tested without a parent

expected_outputs.failing_step_for_combination_two: the configuration filter, because Colour White excludes Size L

worked_examples.narrative: The accepted pair passes the filter, finds an active variant and meets no parent exclusion. The excluded pair never reaches the variant lookup, because the filter refuses it first.

worked_examples.description: A dynamic template whose variant has been archived

expected_outputs.failing_step: a variant was found and it is archived on a dynamic template

worked_examples.narrative: The configuration filter accepts the pair, but the archived variant of a dynamic template is a deliberate refusal, so the create-on-demand procedure will return the archived record rather than reactivating it.

records.name: The possibility predicate applied to an existing variant
records.purpose: Answers whether an existing variant may still be ordered, by applying the full predicate to the variant's own stored combination with the attributes that never create variants ignored.

operands.name: stored combination of the variant
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the Product Variant
operands.constraints: holds only members of attributes that create variants

operands.name: parent combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values of the parent product, no unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: may be empty

preconditions.condition: The flag that ignores attributes which never create variants is set.
preconditions.otherwise: The configuration filter would count the lines of such attributes against a combination that by construction cannot hold their values, and every variant would be judged impossible.

procedure: Take the variant's own stored combination.
Apply the full possibility predicate to it, with the parent combination when one was given and with attributes that never create variants ignored.
Return the verdict, which for a variant of a non-dynamic template reduces to: the configuration still accepts its members, the variant is active, and no parent value forbids one of its members.
records.formula: possible( variant ) = possible( variant.combination, parent_combination, ignore_no_variant_attributes = true )

rounding.what: Nothing; the result is a verdict.

result.name: possibility verdict for the variant
result.stored_or_displayed: displayed where a variant is offered for selection; never stored

edge_cases.case: The variant is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: False on a non-dynamic template and false on a dynamic one, since both branches refuse an archived variant that was found.

edge_cases.case: One of the variant's members has been archived since the variant was created.
edge_cases.outcome: False on the subset test of the configuration filter, because the member is no longer among the active materialised values.

edge_cases.case: An exclusion was added between two of the variant's own members.
edge_cases.outcome: False, and the next generation pass removes or archives the variant.

worked_examples.description: An existing variant whose colour value was archived

expected_outputs.failing_step: the subset test of the configuration filter

worked_examples.narrative: The variant is still active, but one of its members is no longer an active materialised value of the line, so the combination is refused and the variant stops being offered.

records.name: The attribute-exclusion payload sent to a configurator
records.purpose: Assembles everything a configurator or a storefront needs to grey out impossible answers and explain each refusal, in one record computed for a template, optionally in the context of a parent product.

operands.name: template
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: its valid attribute lines supply the values

operands.name: parent combination and parent product display name
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of values and a text, no unit
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: both optional; the display name is supplied rather than recomputed

operands.name: combination of interest
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: its members count as eligible even when archived

operands.name: identifier tuples of the template's archived variants and of its active variants
operands.source: the template's variants
operands.constraints: an archived tuple is kept only when all its values are active or belong to the combination of interest

preconditions.condition: The caller supplies the parent product's display name when it wants the explanations to name the parent.
preconditions.otherwise: The explanation is built without it and reads less helpfully.

procedure: Compute the own-exclusion map and complete it with its inverse pairs; that is the exclusions entry.

List the identifier tuples of the template's archived variants, keep only those whose values are all active or belong to the combination of interest, and subtract the identifier tuples of the active variants; that is the archived-combinations entry.
Compute the parent-exclusion map; that is the parent-exclusions entry.
Carry the identifiers of the parent combination and the display name of the parent product as supplied.

Build the map from value identifier to display name covering every materialised value of the template's valid attribute lines plus every value of the parent combination, which is what lets the client name the offending value in its explanation.
Return the five entries together with the mapped names.
records.formula:
payload.exclusions = complete_with_inverses( own_exclusion_map )
payload.archived_combinations = { tuples of archived variants whose values are all eligible } − { tuples of active variants }
payload.parent_exclusions = parent_exclusion_map
payload.parent_combination = identifiers of the parent combination
payload.mapped_attribute_names = { value identifier → display name } over the template's values and the parent's values

rounding.what: Nothing; the payload holds identifiers, names and lists.

result.name: attribute-exclusion payload
result.unit_or_currency: a record of five entries plus the name map, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: sent to the configurator or the storefront; never stored

edge_cases.case: A combination has both an archived variant and an active one.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not reported as archived, because the subtraction removes it: the uniqueness index constrains active variants only, so the combination is orderable.

edge_cases.case: An archived variant holds a value that is itself archived and not in the combination of interest.
edge_cases.outcome: Its tuple is dropped from the archived-combinations entry, because the client could not render the value anyway.

edge_cases.case: No parent combination is given.
edge_cases.outcome: The parent-exclusions entry and the parent-combination entry are empty and the name map covers the template's values alone.

worked_examples.description: A template with one archived variant whose combination is also served by an active one
worked_examples.narrative: The first archived tuple is also an active tuple, so the subtraction removes it and the client keeps offering it. Only the second is reported as archived and greyed out.

records.name: Finding the variant that serves a combination
records.purpose: Resolves a chosen combination to at most one variant, deterministically, so that two readers of the same catalogue reach the same record.

operands.name: template
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: the search is restricted to its variants

operands.name: combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: may hold members of attributes that never create variants, which are removed first

preconditions.condition: The identifiers of the members are whole numbers, so that the key can be sorted numerically.
preconditions.otherwise: The key would not match the stored combination indices.

procedure: Remove the members whose attribute never creates variants, giving the filtered combination.
Compute the filtered combination's identifier string.
Search the variants of the template, archived ones included, whose combination indices equal that string, or, when the string is empty, whose combination indices are empty or unset.
Order the matches by activity flag descending and keep the first, so that an active variant wins over an archived one carrying the same combination.
Return that variant, or nothing when no match exists.
records.formula:
key = join_with_comma( sort_ascending( identifiers of filtered_combination ) )
found_variant = first of ( variants of template with combination_indices = key, archived included, ordered by active descending )
found_variant = first of ( variants with combination_indices empty or unset ) when key is empty

rounding.what: Nothing; the lookup is by text key.

result.name: the variant serving the combination
result.unit_or_currency: at most one record, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: returned to the caller; the lookup is cached on the pair made of the template identifier and the frozen set of the filtered combination's identifiers

edge_cases.case: Both an active and an archived variant carry the same key.
edge_cases.outcome: The active one is returned, because the ordering puts the activity flag first in descending order.

edge_cases.case: The key is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: A variant whose combination indices are empty and a variant whose combination indices are unset both match.

edge_cases.case: The cache holds a stale entry.
edge_cases.outcome: It is invalidated whenever a variant is created, whenever a variant's combination is written and whenever a variant is activated or archived.

edge_cases.case: The reader may not read every variant.
edge_cases.outcome: The lookup is performed as a privileged reader so that the cache is shared by all users and the answer does not depend on who asks.

worked_examples.description: Resolving a chosen configuration that includes a value of an attribute which never creates variants
worked_examples.narrative: The member of the attribute that never creates variants is dropped before the key is built, so the key is a single identifier. Two variants carry it, and the ordering by activity flag descending returns the active one.

records.name: Creating a variant on demand
records.purpose: Produces the variant a buyer's configuration needs on a template whose attributes create variants dynamically, so that a large catalogue holds only the combinations somebody has actually ordered.

operands.name: template
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: creation happens only when it has at least one dynamic attribute

operands.name: complete combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the configurator or the document line
operands.constraints: must hold every member, including those of attributes that never create variants, because possibility depends on them

operands.name: flag saying whether a failure is recorded in the technical log
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: affects logging only, never the outcome

preconditions.condition: The combination handed in is complete.
preconditions.otherwise: A parent exclusion carried by a member of an attribute that never creates variants would be missed and an impossible variant could be created.

procedure: Find the variant for the combination.

When one exists, reactivate it only when all three hold: it is archived, the template has a dynamic attribute and the full possibility predicate accepts the combination; then return it in either case.
Return nothing when the template has no dynamic attribute, optionally recording that a user tried to create a variant for a fully generated product.
Return nothing when the full possibility predicate rejects the combination, optionally recording that a user tried to create an invalid variant.
Otherwise create a variant, as a privileged writer, carrying the template and the combination restricted to attributes that create variants.
Create the first variant of a template by applying this same procedure to the first possible combination.
records.formula:
on_demand_variant = found_variant                       when a variant exists
on_demand_variant = nothing                              when the template has no dynamic attribute or possible( combination ) is false
on_demand_variant = new variant( template, filtered_combination )   otherwise
variant_sales_price = template_sales_price + sum_of( extra_price of the members of the filtered combination )

rounding.what: The sales price the new variant reports.
rounding.precision: The `Product Price` decimal precision, two digits by default.
rounding.step: At display of the price; the creation itself rounds nothing.

result.name: the variant serving the chosen configuration
result.unit_or_currency: at most one record, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: stored as a Product Variant when one is created; returned to the caller in every branch

edge_cases.case: The found variant is archived on a dynamic template and the combination is still allowed by the configuration.
edge_cases.outcome: The possibility predicate returns false precisely because the variant is archived, so the reactivation branch is not taken and the archived variant is returned as it stands; the consuming domain must test possibility before using it.

edge_cases.case: The template has no dynamic attribute and the combination has no variant.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is created and nothing is returned, because a fully generated template already holds every variant it will ever hold.

edge_cases.case: The caller is not allowed to write products.
edge_cases.outcome: The creation is performed as a privileged writer, so an ordinary buyer configuring an option still obtains a variant.

edge_cases.case: The combination names a value of an attribute that never creates variants.
edge_cases.outcome: That member is used for the possibility test and is then dropped, so it never reaches the stored combination.

worked_examples.description: A dynamically created variant of a pen with two dynamic attributes
worked_examples.narrative: The configuration filter accepts the pair, no variant is found, the template is dynamic, so one variant is created carrying both members. Its supplement is three plus six, that is nine, and its sales price is forty plus nine, that is forty-nine.

worked_examples.description: A second configuration on the same dynamic template
worked_examples.narrative: The template now holds two variants out of six possible combinations; the remaining four come into existence only when somebody orders them.

worked_examples.description: The same configuration after its variant has been archived
worked_examples.narrative: The archived variant is found, but the possibility predicate refuses an archived variant of a dynamic template, so the reactivation branch is skipped and the caller receives the archived record unchanged.

records.name: The pruned cartesian product of a template's values
records.purpose: Enumerates the combinations of a template while testing exclusions as values are added, so that a branch ruled out by the second value is never carried to the last.

operands.name: list of value lists, one per attribute line
operands.unit_or_currency: lists of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the caller, which contributes an empty list for a multi-checkbox line
operands.constraints: the lines are in the template's own order and each list is in the values' own order

operands.name: parent combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of values of the parent product, no unit
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: own-exclusion map expressed as value to set of excluded values
operands.source: the template's exclusion records
operands.constraints: holds a key for every eligible value

operands.name: rejection counter per value
operands.source: initialised to zero, then increased by one for every value named as a key of the parent-exclusion map
operands.constraints: a value whose counter is greater than zero may not enter the partial combination

preconditions.condition: The list of value lists is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: The enumeration stops with no output at all.

preconditions.condition: At least one list holds a value, unless every list is empty.
preconditions.otherwise: When every list is empty the empty combination is emitted once, which is the only place it is emitted.

procedure: Stop with no output when the input list is empty.
Drop the empty value lists, except that when every list was empty the empty combination is emitted once and the enumeration stops.
Build the own-exclusion map as a map from value to the set of values it excludes.
Build the rejection counter at zero for every value and increase it by one for each value named as a key of the parent-exclusion map.
Set the partial combination empty, the chosen index of every line to minus one and the line cursor to the first line.

Read the value list and the chosen index of the line at the cursor; when the list is empty, which happens only for a multi-checkbox line, emit the partial combination if the cursor is on the last line and otherwise advance the cursor.
When the chosen index is at least zero, the current value leaves the partial combination: decrease the rejection counter of every value it excludes and remove it from the partial combination.

When the chosen index is not the last index of the list, increase it by one and read the new current value; otherwise, when the cursor is not on the first line, reset this line's chosen index to minus one, move the cursor to the previous line and continue; otherwise stop, the first line being exhausted.
The new current value enters the partial combination: increase the rejection counter of every value it excludes and add it to the partial combination.

Continue the loop without emitting when the new value's own rejection counter is greater than zero, or when any value it excludes is already in the partial combination; the next iteration tries the following value of the same line.
Emit the partial combination when the cursor is on the last line; otherwise advance the cursor to the next line.
records.formula:
rejection_counter( v ) = number of values currently in the partial combination that exclude v  +  1 for each parent value that forbids v
v may enter when rejection_counter( v ) = 0 and excluded_by( v ) ∩ partial_combination = ∅
emitted_combinations ⊆ cartesian_product( value_lists )

rounding.what: Nothing; the counters are whole numbers and the output is a stream of sets.

result.name: stream of candidate combinations
result.unit_or_currency: sets of Template Attribute Values, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: consumed by the enumeration of possible combinations; never stored

edge_cases.case: Every value list is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The empty combination is emitted once and the enumeration stops; this is the only place the empty combination is produced.

edge_cases.case: Some lists are empty and some are not.
edge_cases.outcome: The empty ones are dropped, so a multi-checkbox line contributes nothing and the emitted combinations simply hold no value from it.

edge_cases.case: A value is forbidden by the parent product.
edge_cases.outcome: Its rejection counter starts above zero and it never enters a partial combination, so no branch beneath it is explored.

edge_cases.case: The consumer keeps the emitted combination.
edge_cases.outcome: The stream yields the same collection object each time, mutated in place, so a consumer that wants to keep a combination must copy it; the consumers in this domain test it or add it to another set at once.

worked_examples.description: Three sizes and two colours with one exclusion, enumerated with pruning
worked_examples.narrative: The enumeration walks the sizes in the outer position and the colours in the inner one. When Size L holds the partial combination and Colour White is tried, the value it excludes is already present, so the pair is never emitted; five of the six products of the plain enumeration survive.

records.name: The possible combinations of a template, in sequence order
records.purpose: Streams every combination of a template that may be ordered, in the order a configurator asks its questions, optionally keeping a set of values the caller insists on.

operands.name: template
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: an archived template yields nothing

operands.name: parent combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of values of the parent product, no unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: necessary values
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: every emitted combination holds all of them

preconditions.condition: The template is active.
preconditions.otherwise: The enumeration stops with no output and reports the explanatory text "The product template is archived so no combination is possible.", which callers treat as exhaustion.

procedure: Stop with no output when the template is archived.
Take the attribute lines of the necessary values as the necessary lines, and let the lines be the template's valid attribute lines minus those.
Emit the necessary values alone when the remaining lines are empty and the full possibility predicate accepts them with the parent combination.
For each remaining line in the template's attribute-line order, contribute its active materialised values in their own order when its display type is not multi-checkbox, and an empty list otherwise.
Run the pruned enumeration over those lists with the parent combination.
For each emitted partial combination, form the union with the necessary values and emit it when the full possibility predicate accepts it with the parent combination.
Stop when the enumeration is exhausted, reporting the explanatory text "There are no remaining possible combination.".
records.formula:
possible_combinations = { necessary_values ∪ c : c emitted by pruned_product( lines − necessary_lines ) and possible( necessary_values ∪ c, parent_combination ) }
ordering = by attribute line sequence, then by attribute value sequence

rounding.what: Nothing; the output is a stream of sets.

result.name: stream of possible combinations
result.unit_or_currency: sets of Template Attribute Values, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: consumed by the configurator, by the closest-combination search and by the creation of a template's first variant; never stored

edge_cases.case: The necessary values already cover every line.
edge_cases.outcome: The remaining lines are empty; the necessary values are emitted alone when the predicate accepts them, and nothing at all when it does not.

edge_cases.case: The template has no attribute line.
edge_cases.outcome: The pruned enumeration receives an empty list of lists and emits nothing, so the caller sees an empty stream even though the empty combination is possible; a caller that needs to tell the two apart re-tests the answer with the predicate.

edge_cases.case: The template is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: No combination is emitted, and the explanatory text stands in for the absence of results.

edge_cases.case: A line uses a multi-checkbox display type.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes an empty list, so no value of it appears in the emitted combinations.

worked_examples.description: Enumerating a two-line template with one exclusion and no necessary values
worked_examples.narrative: Five of the six combinations survive both the pruning and the possibility predicate, and they arrive ordered by the size line first, since it has the lower sequence, and by the value order within each size.

worked_examples.description: Enumerating with one necessary value
worked_examples.narrative: The size line is a necessary line and drops out of the enumeration; the colour line yields two candidates, of which the possibility predicate accepts one.

records.name: The first possible combination of a template
records.purpose: Gives the combination a configurator opens on and the combination the creation of a template's first variant uses.

operands.name: stream of possible combinations
operands.unit_or_currency: sets of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: the enumeration of possible combinations for the template
operands.constraints: ordered by attribute line sequence then by attribute value sequence

preconditions.condition: The caller re-tests the answer with the possibility predicate when it must distinguish an empty answer from an impossible template.
preconditions.otherwise: The empty combination is returned both when it is genuinely the answer and when no combination is possible at all.

procedure: Ask the enumeration of possible combinations for its first element.
Return that element when the stream yields one.
Return the empty combination when the stream is empty.
When the caller is creating the template's first variant, hand that combination to the create-on-demand procedure.
records.formula:
first_possible_combination = first element of possible_combinations( template, parent_combination )
first_possible_combination = empty combination when the stream is empty

rounding.what: Nothing; the output is a set.

result.name: first possible combination
result.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
result.stored_or_displayed: used to open a configurator and to create a template's first variant; never stored as such

edge_cases.case: No combination is possible.
edge_cases.outcome: The empty combination is returned, which is indistinguishable from the genuine empty answer unless the caller re-tests it.

edge_cases.case: The template has no attribute line.
edge_cases.outcome: The stream is empty and the empty combination is returned, which is also the correct answer for such a template.

edge_cases.case: The template is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: The stream is empty and the empty combination is returned.

worked_examples.description: Opening a configurator on a template whose first size is excluded with the first colour
worked_examples.narrative: The enumeration tries Size S with Colour Black first, the exclusion refuses it, and the next candidate in value order is Size S with Colour White, which is the combination the configurator opens on.

records.name: The closest possible combinations to a desired one
records.purpose: Recovers a usable configuration when a buyer arrives with one that is incomplete, impossible or both, by giving up the most recently answered question first.

operands.name: desired combination
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Template Attribute Values, no unit
operands.source: a pre-filled link, a restored session or a partially answered configurator
operands.constraints: may be incomplete, may be impossible, may be empty

operands.name: members of the desired combination in order
operands.source: the combination, ordered by attribute line then by attribute value
operands.constraints: the order is what makes the search deterministic

preconditions.condition: The members are ordered by attribute line and then by attribute value.
preconditions.otherwise: Dropping the last member would not correspond to the most recently answered question and two systems could return different answers.

procedure: Ask for the possible combinations with the current desired combination as necessary values.
Emit that stream in full and stop when it yields at least one element, reporting the explanatory text "There are no remaining closest combination." when it is exhausted.
Stop when the stream is empty and the desired combination is already empty, reporting the explanatory text "There are no possible combination.".
Otherwise drop the last member of the desired combination and repeat, which gives up the value of the attribute that appears last in the configurator.
records.formula:
closest_stream( desired ) = possible_combinations( necessary_values = desired )        when that stream is non-empty
closest_stream( desired ) = closest_stream( desired minus its last member )               otherwise, until desired is empty
closest_possible_combination = first element of closest_stream( desired )

rounding.what: Nothing; the output is a stream of sets.

result.name: stream of closest possible combinations, whose first element is the closest possible combination
